This document outlines the visual inspection activities I1, to be performed on
an annually bases Y1 as indicated in the above title block. The 1st draft
initiated by Demo substation, eng. Abd Eltawab Ramadan from ME. The first review 
at Nov. 2007

items:
Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area.

CB must be
 isolated and proper earthing at the two sides of CB is required.

Interrupt
 remote control and motor circuits (this achieved by receiving the multi-pin
 plug at the left hand side at the operating mechanism)

Switch breaker
 ON and OFF manually in order to discharge the closing and springs.

Determine the SF6
 gas pressure with the plug-in manometer and compare
 with value from the gas pressure curve-top-up with SF6 gas if the pressure has dropped to about the
 level of tapping-up (refilling) pressure.

Trip dash-pot
 (damper); check the oil level in the dash pot with the piston in the
 "OFF" position. If there are traces of oil at the top end of the
 dash pot the dash pot must be replaced.

Read the 
 operating counter read-off and record the number of switching operations.

text:
Substations | Technical Procedure
This document outlines the visual inspection activities I1, to be performed on
an annually bases Y1 as indicated in the above title block. The 1st draft
initiated by Demo substation, eng. Abd Eltawab Ramadan from ME. The first review 
at Nov. 2007
Safety 
Precautions
Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area.
CB must be
 isolated and proper earthing at the two sides of CB is required.
Interrupt
 remote control and motor circuits (this achieved by receiving the multi-pin
 plug at the left hand side at the operating mechanism)
Switch breaker
 ON and OFF manually in order to discharge the closing and springs.
Tools and Equipments
Safety equipment "belt,
 shoes, ...,etc".
Work to be carried out
Determine the SF6
 gas pressure with the plug-in manometer and compare
 with value from the gas pressure curve-top-up with SF6 gas if the pressure has dropped to about the
 level of tapping-up (refilling) pressure.
Trip dash-pot
 (damper); check the oil level in the dash pot with the piston in the
 "OFF" position. If there are traces of oil at the top end of the
 dash pot the dash pot must be replaced.
Read the 
 operating counter read-off and record the number of switching operations.

sections_ar.text: توضح هذه الوثيقة أنشطة الفحص البصري I1، التي يجب تنفيذها سنويًا كما هو موضح بالرمز Y1 في خانة العنوان أعلاه. وقد بدأ المسودة الأولى محطة Demo الفرعية، م. Abd Eltawab Ramadan من منطقة ME. وكانت أول مراجعة في Nov. 2007

items: سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير تحيط بمنطقة العمل.
يجب عزل القاطع، ويلزم التأريض الصحيح على جانبي القاطع.
افصل دوائر التحكم عن بُعد ودوائر الموتور (ويتم ذلك بنزع القابس متعدد الأطراف على الجانب الأيسر عند آلية التشغيل)
شغّل القاطع يدويًا تشغيلًا وإيقافًا لتفريغ نوابض الغلق والفتح.
حدد ضغط غاز SF6 بالمانومتر القابل للتوصيل، وقارنه بالقيمة من منحنى ضغط الغاز؛ وأعد التعبئة بغاز SF6 إذا انخفض الضغط إلى نحو مستوى ضغط التعبئة (إعادة الملء).
داشبوت الفصل (المخمد)؛ افحص مستوى الزيت في الداشبوت والمكبس في وضع "الإيقاف". وإذا وُجدت آثار زيت عند الطرف العلوي للداشبوت، فيجب استبدال الداشبوت.
اقرأ عداد التشغيل وسجّل عدد عمليات الفصل والتوصيل.
